scripts.build: npm run build -w @voyaspan/web && npm run build -w @voyaspan/api
scripts.test:firestore: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-alozuri --config infra/production-emulator.json "node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 apps/api/test/production.firestore.mts apps/api/test/commerce.firestore.mts apps/api/test/catalogue.firestore.mts apps/api/test/featured.firestore.mts"
scripts.test:auth: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-alozuri --config infra/auth-emulator.json "node --import tsx --test tests/integration/checkout-account.auth.mts"
scripts.test:stripe: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-alozuri --config infra/production-emulator.json "node --import tsx scripts/run-stripe-e2e.mts"
scripts.test:cart:browser: firebase emulators:exec --only auth --project demo-alozuri --config infra/auth-emulator.json "E2E_CART_AUTH_EMULATOR=true playwright test tests/e2e/cart-auth.spec.ts"
